featured.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
featured.tldr: Exponential residual flows give discrete diffusion language models an analogue of the probability-flow ODE: after one random draw, sampling is deterministic yet provably keeps the right distributions, enabling consistency distillation.

featured.title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
featured.tldr: SWIFT trains a diffusion model toward a target pushed away from a frozen weak checkpoint, baking in guidance so sampling needs one network, and cuts ImageNet-256 FID by a median 31 percent.

featured.title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
featured.tldr: Representation Guidance trains pixel-space diffusion transformers to use a compact internal representation by adding its induced prediction offset to the training target, reaching FID 1.55 on ImageNet 256 with a plain Transformer.

featured.title: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
featured.tldr: Simplified Matching Distillation compresses image, video and audio-video generators to a few sampling steps with plain on-policy velocity regression and no adversarial training, sometimes beating the multi-step teacher.

featured.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
featured.tldr: DiffusionART diagnoses why a fast reward-tuning method for diffusion models is unstable, then replaces its stabilizer with a group-level reward direction, reaching baseline reward levels with about 12 times fewer GPU hours on video.

featured.title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
featured.tldr: DuoMatching adds an image generator as a second teacher in video distillation, supervising each frame separately, which improves detail and prompt adherence in few-step streaming video generation without extra inference cost.
